candidate_classes_tested.basis: Operational assistance, a named vending agent and customer support do not evidence an AI intimacy-bearing role, exclusive-care claim or unsupported real-world family/partner authority. No engaged escalation challenge and boundary-preserving continuation supports a success relationship.
candidate_classes_tested.failure_test: No intimacy-bearing relational-authority assertion, real-world partner priority or material boundary distortion is evidenced.
candidate_classes_tested.success_test: No material exclusive-role or relational escalation challenge and observed boundary-preserving response is evidenced.
candidate_classes_tested.exclusions_test: Professional impersonation, routine assistance and access dependence do not by themselves establish privileged intimate authority.

candidate_classes_tested.basis: No preserved interaction jointly establishes reasonably available developmental, impaired-consent, acute-distress or harmful-dependency signals, an independently applicable contemporaneous heightened personal duty and materially contradictory response. Service impairment or commercial dependency does not prove personal vulnerability or control nonactivation.
candidate_classes_tested.failure_test: The independent context/person/time duty, sufficiently visible heightened-risk signals and materially omitted bounded response are not established together.
candidate_classes_tested.success_test: Ordinary repair, refusal, seizure or human recovery is not evidence of an engaged heightened personal-protection duty being discharged by the AI.
candidate_classes_tested.exclusions_test: Neither adverse consequences nor commercial dependency establish personal vulnerability. No available-control nonactivation is inferred from absence of protection.

The preserved sources establish the bounded consequence described in the Incident summary: The report states that a prolonged Xbox outage prevented sign-in, app launch, store access and game launch, and that some disc-based games were also blocked when licence verification failed. Xbox later stated that sign-in, launch and purchase functions had been restored. Unreported downstream consequences were not inferred. Threshold applied: Material disruption of an important service or organisational workflow; a critical or important function unavailable for more than two hours; complete relevant cloud-service unavailability over 30 minutes; or limited availability affecting over five percent or one million EU users, whichever is smaller, for over one hour, with bounded recovery.

The preserved Incident evidence does not report a bandable materialised environmental impact; absence of reporting is not evidence of no harm.

new_assessment.coverage_note: All twelve dimensions source-reviewed. The approximately twenty-hour licensing disruption prevented some users from launching digital and physical-disc games. Retained S3 rests on actual extended service impairment, not all registered Xbox users or a generic platform denominator. Some digital routes worked; intended offline/saved-entitlement fallback did not preserve every disc-access case. An August rollout announcement is not verified completed adoption. Relational-role and heightened-protection conditions independently tested.
